visual_brief.subject: An agent's behavioral contract remains externally enforceable across its production lifecycle
verified_context: Uber describes a production architecture combining provisioning-time validation, runtime behavioral enforcement and continuous assurance for AI agents.
The system treats an agent's persona, permitted intents, constraints and dependencies as a behavioral contract that follows the agent into production.
The report is a first-party architecture account rather than proof of universal effectiveness.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Agent purpose becomes an external control boundary rather than a self-declared prompt instruction.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A terracotta route passes through three weighty inspection chambers enclosed by one external segmented lock-ring.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant. The three checkpoints are explicit and crop-safe, but the symmetrical amphitheater is less distinctive and reads more literally than the selected physical boundary metaphor.
candidate_notes.B: Selected. Three chambers are integrated into one externally governed ring while the terracotta route remains continuous and legible through the structure.
candidate_notes.C: Rejected before scoring because the human figure adds an unsupported narrative actor and weakens the story-specific lifecycle-control metaphor.

crop_review.article_desktop: The ring, three chambers and terracotta route remain visible across the wide hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop retains the full central route and all three inspection chambers.
crop_review.thumbnail: The ring-and-route silhouette remains distinct at 320px without depending on fine detail.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate shares the security references' warm paper field, dark containment mass, sparse terracotta signal and physical editorial metaphor. It is more volumetric and denser than the especially airy DNS reference, so Golden Reference Fit is scored at 86.
